# Bike Analytics — AnalyticsZone

> Privacy-first cycling analytics for iOS and Apple Watch: Critical Power (CP), W′ (W prime), FTP, and training load computed locally on your device — no cloud uploads.

Bike Analytics tracks FTP, TSS, and Critical Power for road cyclists, mountain bikers, and coaches. All metrics are based on peer-reviewed sports science and computed on-device.

## Key pages

- [Critical Power](https://bike.analyticszone.app/en/critical-power/): The CP/W′ model explained, with an interactive CP & W′ calculator.
- [FTP vs Critical Power](https://bike.analyticszone.app/en/ftp-vs-critical-power/): Protocols, what each predicts, and when they diverge.
- [FTP](https://bike.analyticszone.app/en/ftp/): Functional Threshold Power — testing and using it.
- [Power Metrics](https://bike.analyticszone.app/en/power-metrics/): Normalized power, intensity factor, and related metrics.
- [Training Load](https://bike.analyticszone.app/en/training-load/): TSS-based load, fitness, and fatigue.
- [TSS Calculator](https://bike.analyticszone.app/en/tss-calculator/): Interactive Training Stress Score calculator.
- [Training Zones](https://bike.analyticszone.app/en/training-zones/): Power-based training zones.
- [Formulas](https://bike.analyticszone.app/en/formulas/): Every formula the app uses, with references.

## Key facts

- The two-parameter critical power model is P(t) = CP + W′/t (Monod & Scherrer, 1965): CP is the highest metabolically sustainable power, W′ is the finite work capacity (in joules) available above CP.
- FTP and CP are related but not identical: FTP is a ~1-hour practical threshold estimate, while CP is the asymptote of the power–duration curve, typically estimated from 2–3 maximal efforts of 2–15 minutes.
- W′ balance (W′bal) models how much anaerobic work capacity remains during a ride as you burn W′ above CP and recover it below CP.
- All calculations run locally on the device; no training data is sent to any cloud.
